_comment: A NET THAT DOES NOT WORK, kept because it does not work. See Findings.md 8.
Two enumerations that share a constructor name. Definition 5 places no constraint
on this -- colour sets are sets, and nothing says two of them may not both contain
an element called a -- and InputFormat.md 4.3 does not check it. But the emitted
and mcrl22lps refuses it: Double declaration of constructor constant a.
All three translators emit exactly this, byte for byte, so leg A is blind to it;
no fixture in the repository declares two enumerations, so nothing else covers it.
It was found by scripts/fuzz.py, at seven of the first thirty seeds.
It is NOT in corpus/expected.tsv, because it fails and the fix is a decision about
the project rather than about this directory: either T1 gains a check that
constructor names are globally unique, or the printer qualifies them per sort.
